messages:
Leah: Quick UX thread on the Stygian theme patch 1: chart accents, inline code color, and toggle copy. Short replies please.
Omar: Chart accents: when multiple series overlap the current palette flattens. Propose increasing lightness delta and adding a 1px semi-transparent stroke between areas.
Jen: Inline code uses bright aqua right now 1 which blinds on OLED. Move identifiers to a muted teal (lower sat), keep bright aqua for links only. Also slightly darken code block bg for 13px text.
Marco: Toggle copy: drop "Dim" label. Use "Appearance: Light / Dark / System" and add aria-label="Toggle appearance". Tooltip: "T to toggle".
Leah: Heatmap idea: use luminance-first ramp for ordering + subtle chroma layer for richness. Avoid per-cell textures to keep paint costs low.
Omar: Perf note: prefer CSS borders or single composite canvas pass for separators. PM wants <10ms extra paint on mid mobile.
Jen: Accessibility: legends and axis ticks should be >=14px or meet 4.5:1. If 12px fails, bump to 14px.
design-bot: Created task STYG-1071 and attached frames + tokens (internal Figma).
Leah: I'll update tokens and drop two variants in STYG-1071, then schedule a 15-min sync Friday. Thanks :thumbsup:
